explication: Mochy is an Android music player whose main user journey is selecting music, resolving it through a source, and listening through the playback service; it also supports local and account-based imports, downloads, lyrics, recognition, audio processing, and connected-service features. The graph emphasizes these product areas and their documented internal dependencies. Some feature-to-feature wiring is not visible in the sampled excerpts, so those links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred.
